content.title: Single standard deduction recalculates live and shows the ordered estimate breakdown
content.intent: Prove the calculator recalculates live without submit or reload and presents the ordered estimate breakdown, gross income echo, Single standard deduction, and an allowed total label.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning with the PRD's representative annual income 85000 and filing status Single. Applied state/flow to cover live recalculation while typing. Risk-judged interaction strength was 3 because money applies, but no covering array was used: filing status and deduction type change expected outcomes and were split into separate scenarios. Negative validation, i18n, a11y, and responsiveness were not minted because this calculator source states no such promises and localization/mobile are explicit non-goals.
